Overview.Name: Sruthi
Overview.Food_Habit: I can eat one bite and stop
Overview.Goal: Looking better (appearance), Feeling energetic & confident, Preventing/reversing health issues, Mental wellbeing & stress reduction

Meal_1: Option 1: Vegetable dosa (1) & paneer cubes (60 g)
Option 2: Idli (2) & sambar (1 cup) & paneer bhurji (60 g paneer)
Meal_2: Option 1: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & dal (1 bowl) & vegetable curry
Option 2: Cooked rice (3/4 cup cooked ~110 g) & chicken curry (small portion) & spinach curry
Option 3: 2 chapati & paneer curry (80 g paneer) & salad
Meal_3: Option 1: Cooked rice (1/2 cup cooked ~75 g) & dal (light) & vegetable curry
Option 2: Grilled chicken (small portion) & cucumber salad
Option 3: Clear vegetable soup (1 large bowl) & paneer cubes (60 g)

Notes_and_Tips: Eggs are excluded as mentioned, so focus more on paneer, dal and occasional chicken for protein.
Since PCOD is present, keep protein steady in every meal and reduce very oily foods.
Stress and boredom can increase fried cravings, so keep makhana or paneer ready as a quick option.
For better appearance results, keep rice moderate and protein portions consistent.
Simple home style cooking will help you stay consistent even with shift work.
